build_safety_mix_dataset: build the safety_mix dataset by downloading single_turn_safety.json and generating troll-type splits for train, valid, and test folds
generate_user_based_dataset: generate a user-based dataset with configurable troll type ratios and noise levels from standard and adversarial safety samples
flip_labels: flip labels on a percentage of samples using deterministic MD5 hashing to simulate noisy annotations
analysis_dataset: analyze a dataset to count standard vs adversarial samples, flipped labels, and duplicated text entries
save_dataset_for_two_class: save a dataset as JSONL files split into positive and negative classes for balanced two-class training
